> One Hot Mess is a high-octane classic rock cover band based in Northern Virginia, known for incredible vocal harmonies and electrifying live performances. Voted Best of Prince William 2023.

## What this site is
The official website for One Hot Mess, a classic rock cover band playing local venues across Northern Virginia. The site includes event listings, an EPK (electronic press kit), band photos, and booking information.

## Key pages
- **Homepage:** https://www.onehotmess.band/ — band overview, upcoming events, hero video
- **EPK:** https://www.onehotmess.band/epk.html — electronic press kit with photos, video, song list, stage plot
- **Events:** https://www.onehotmess.band/ — upcoming shows listed on homepage via events.json

## Band info
- **Genre:** Classic rock covers
- **Location:** Northern Virginia / Prince William area
- **Awards:** Voted Best of Prince William 2023
- **Highlights:** Incredible vocal harmonies, electrifying live performances
- **Booking:** Available for local venues, private events, and parties

## Contact
- Website: https://www.onehotmess.band
- EPK: https://www.onehotmess.band/epk.html
